page_title.en: Posy's Egg Cartons — Count by Tens to 100 (Kindergarten)
page_title.de: In Zehnerschritten zählen bis 100 – Klasse 2 | Gratis

page_intro.en: Posy the hen packs her eggs into cartons of ten! Each carton holds exactly 10 eggs, so the fast way to count them is by tens — 10, 20, 30… Count Posy's full cartons by tens and tap the total. A Kindergarten counting game about counting to 100 by tens, aligned to Common Core K.CC.A.1.
page_intro.de: In Zehnerschritten zählen bis 100: Posy packt Eier in Zehner-Kartons – ein kostenloses, interaktives Spiel für Klasse 2. Jetzt online üben!

kid_prompt_template: Count the cartons by tens and tap the total.
